hypotheses.justification: pullback d a F = F ∘ liftChart (powerChart d a), where powerChart d a R = (positiveRadius (a/4) R) ^ d and positiveRadius ℓ x = ℓ + (x - ℓ) * smoothTransition ((x - ℓ)/ℓ). positiveRadius_contDiff ℓ holds for every ℓ. ha is used only to get positiveRadius (a/4) R ≠ 0, which ContDiff.rpow_const_of_ne needs. Without ha: (1) if a = 0, then (x-0)/0 = 0, so positiveRadius 0 x = x * smoothTransition 0 = 0 (Real.smoothTransition.zero). powerChart d 0 is the constant 0^d, smooth by contDiff_const. (2) if a < 0, put ℓ = a/4 < 0. For x ≥ ℓ, (x-ℓ)/ℓ ≤ 0, so smoothTransition gives 0 (smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos) and the value is ℓ. For x < ℓ, (x-ℓ) < 0 and smoothTransition ≥ 0 (smoothTransition.nonneg), so the value is ≤ ℓ. Hence positiveRadius ℓ x ≤ ℓ < 0 never vanishes, and ContDiff.rpow_const_of_ne applies. (3) if a > 0, this is the existing proof. Then liftChart_contDiff and hF.comp finish as before. Nothing else in the statement mentions ha.
